title: Boot refused: destructive schema change requires an itemized acknowledgment token
body: A model change includes a genuinely destructive item (a dropped field, dropped concept, or a narrowing/incompatible type change) and the app has no matching acknowledgment. SchemaLifecycleExecutor never applies a destructive change silently -- it computes the exact expected token (sha256 of the target fingerprint + every destructive item's stable string, sorted) and refuses unless a matching token is supplied. Fix: (1) preview the plan with `Build-NpdevApp.ps1 -Upgrade -PlanOnly` -- it prints the exact same token this refusal expects, plus a plain-English itemization of what's safe vs. destructive; (2) authorize it either by re-running with `-AcknowledgeDestructive <token>` (threads it into the generated manifest) or by submitting `{toFingerprint, ackToken}` to `POST /api/admin/schema-migration/acknowledge` (SUPERUSER-gated) on the CURRENTLY RUNNING app before deploying the new jar -- either channel is equally trusted, check pending submissions via `GET /api/admin/schema-migration/pending`. The token is bound to BOTH the target fingerprint and the exact set of destructive items -- it changes if either changes, so an old acknowledgment can never silently authorize a different, later change. Note: this refusal message embeds the live fingerprint/token/item-list inline (unquoted), so its normalized signature is highly instance-specific -- rely on keyword matching (destructive, acknowledgment, itemized, fingerprint) rather than an exact signature match to find this card. See docs/SCHEMA_EVOLUTION.md#acknowledging-destructive-changes.
signature: schema fingerprint changed from sha256:old to sha256:new and includes destructive change(s) requiring an explicit, itemized acknowledgment (lnch-1 phase 4). itemized destructive report: [drop_column:users:active:boolean]. expected acknowledgment token: 4a9128a3d8c10cd8428a0a7e6af7c5e4f9fbf11c004d227e4acf6d6e6bc03404. set the generated manifest's destructiveacknowledgment to this token, or submit it via the controlpanel schema-migration screen on the currently running app (lnch-1 phase 6), to proceed -- see docs/schema_evolution.md#acknowledging-destructive-changes
fix: Run `Build-NpdevApp.ps1 -Upgrade -PlanOnly` to get the exact token, then either redeploy with `-AcknowledgeDestructive <token>` or submit it via ControlPanel's `POST /api/admin/schema-migration/acknowledge` on the currently running app before deploying.
